requirement:
When preparing the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`, every terminology definition
referenced by the subject or any contributed source MUST contribute its complete
fenced declaration, including its phrase option. Definitions referenced by those
definitions MUST also be included transitively, without duplicates or
nontermination on cycles.

When an additional source read introduces a terminology dependency, the same
complete, transitive definition set MUST be supplied to the model and recorded
before accepting a submission.
rationale:
I found no gap. The code covers both paragraphs of the requirement, and tests cover each obligation.

**Obligation 1: every definition referenced by the subject or a contributed source is contributed in full, phrase option included.**
- `src/authoring/inputs.rs#impl[AssessmentSources]/fn[prepare]` collects the subject's mandatory selectors. It then calls `definition_inputs` with the contributed inputs and `Some(&subject.text)`, so the subject's own `{term}` references are scanned too.
- `definition_inputs` calls `crate::terms::dependencies` (`src/terms.rs`). That function runs `direct_references`, which reads terms from the subject text and from each contributed input. For Rust it reads comments only. For a requirement or example input it reads the declaration bodies.
- Each resulting name becomes an `InputSelector::Definition` and is resolved by `source_input`. `InputSelector::resolve` in `src/inputs.rs` returns the definition's whole raw declaration lines (`target.raw_lines`), so the fence and `:phrase:` option are included.

**Obligation 2: definitions referenced by those definitions are included transitively, without duplicates or nontermination on cycles.**
- `src/terms.rs#fn[close_dependencies]` is a worklist fixed point over `pending`, which is a `BTreeSet`. A `visited` set stops it from reprocessing a name, so cycles terminate. `required` is also a set, so there are no duplicates. Each definition's body terms are added to `pending`.
- `prepare` also skips any dependency already in `mandatory`.

**Obligation 3: a terminology dependency introduced by an additional source read is supplied to the model and recorded before a submission is accepted.**
- `src/authoring/tools.rs#fn[read]` and `src/authoring/pages.rs#impl[ResultPages]/fn[deliver]` call `additional_definitions` or `definitions_each`. Both use `definition_inputs` on what the read delivered and filter out definitions already recorded.
- They put the definitions into the tool result, which is supplied to the model, and into `delivery.inputs`.
- `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[converse]` adds those inputs to `pending` and calls `sources.record_inputs(&pending)` when the next response arrives. A submission arrives in that response, so it is recorded before it is accepted.

**Tests**
- `inputs.rs#mod[tests]/fn[bundle_combines_direct_references_terms_and_current_existing_selectors]` checks that exactly two definitions appear in the initial inputs.
- `inputs.rs#mod[tests]/fn[mandatory_git_inputs_require_staging_declarations_sources_and_terms]` checks that a term referenced from a source comment brings its definition into the mandatory set.
- `mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[definitions_introduced_by_a_read_are_supplied_and_recorded_before_submission]` uses two definitions that reference each other, so it covers the cycle. It asserts the transitive set `["terms.unit","terms.value"]` once each, with the `:::{definition}` and `:phrase:` lines present. It also checks that the second request carried the definitions and that the recorded evidence contains them.
- `pages.rs#mod[tests]/fn[paged_inputs_carry_their_definitions_and_deliver_only_their_own_inputs]` covers definitions on paged reads.
- `tools.rs#mod[tests]/fn[reading_records_only_delivered_sources_and_their_terms]` covers definitions on item reads and line-range reads.
- All of these tests carry a `{test}` reference to the subject.

text: :::{req} authoring_inputs
When preparing the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`, every terminology definition
referenced by the subject or any contributed source MUST contribute its complete
fenced declaration, including its phrase option. Definitions referenced by those
definitions MUST also be included transitively, without duplicates or
nontermination on cycles.
When an additional source read introduces a terminology dependency, the same
complete, transitive definition set MUST be supplied to the model and recorded
before accepting a submission.
:::{req} mandatory_inputs
The harness MUST construct each assessment's mandatory input set by combining
the contributions specified by the requirements applicable to that subject and
its inputs. A requirement that contributes inputs MUST cite this requirement and
define which sources it contributes and when. The harness MUST include every
applicable contribution, deduplicate identical selections, and report
unresolvable mandatory inputs before inference. The complete set MUST be supplied
in the initial model request.
Generated output under project-root `evidence/`, including symlink aliases, MUST
be omitted from mandatory inputs when the default exclusion applies. An explicit
workspace allow MUST permit those selections; an explicit disallow MUST abort
under {cite}`requirements.authoring.read_denial.mandatory`.
